professionalSummary: Experienced performance engineer with a proven track record designing load scenarios, analysing latency bottlenecks, and providing structured sign‑off inputs for credit monitoring platform releases.  Demonstrated ability to coordinate test windows with lending operations and document performance findings.  (src_178e207022e5, src_3b12d5e70fe8, src_e13bff4aa92c, src_0829edd16e8d)
experienceHighlights: Designed load scenarios for utilisation batch and early‑warning online queries, collecting CPU, memory and database wait metrics for each run. (src_178e207022e5)

Analysed latency distributions for online queries, identified a p95 bottleneck due to a missing index on the facility table, and documented findings in the release performance report. (src_3b12d5e70fe8)
Provided structured performance sign‑off inputs for four releases, maintaining release approval with the platform manager. (src_e13bff4aa92c)
Coordinated performance test windows with lending operations to avoid overlap with month‑end processing, recording agreed windows and responsibility for test data. (src_0829edd16e8d)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: performance report for one release, including scenarios, metrics, p95 analysis, open risks, and sign‑off checklist with platform manager approval note. (src_a1db05c24a0b)
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience in load scenario design, latency analysis, sign‑off input provision, and test window coordination for the credit monitoring platform.  They do not provide evidence of deployment to production environments or ownership of end‑to‑end performance testing beyond the described responsibilities.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess fit.

evidence.text: Designed the load scenarios for the utilisation batch and the early-warning online queries using the team's performance test platform, collecting CPU, memory and database wait metrics for each run.

Analysed latency distributions for the online queries and traced the p95 bottleneck to a missing index on the facility table, documented in the release performance report with the before-and-after measurements.

Provided the performance sign-off inputs for four releases as a structured checklist (scenarios run, thresholds met, open risks); the release approval stayed with the platform manager, who used the inputs at the change advisory board.

Coordinated the performance test windows with lending operations so that batch runs did not overlap with month-end processing, recording the agreed windows and my responsibility for the test data in the test plan.
Responsibilities included load scenario design, bottleneck analysis, sign-off inputs and test-window coordination for the credit monitoring platform over about two years.
evidence.notes: Implied documentation of known limitations and hand-over conditions
